scripts.dev:full: wrangler pages dev -- npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && wrangler pages functions build --outdir dist/_worker.js --output-routes-path dist/_routes.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src shared functions tests public/bootstrap.js vite.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.test: vitest run --exclude tests/scale.test.js && vitest run tests/scale.test.js --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:workflow: vitest run tests/journeyEntryAudit.test.js tests/reviewRevisionPostgres.test.js tests/pipeline.test.js tests/outcomeEvidencePostgres.test.js
